answer: Attackers face rising marginal costs per fake identity while honest agents reach their reward zenith cheaply, and hollow zero-stake accounts are rejected outright by peers. At the quill attestation gate, each agent must burn a non-trivial stake and complete a unique proof-of-work prior to voting; duplicate identities inherit the same stake key, so sybil clones collapse into one registered signer. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
